brief: Make a small, funny browser game about a goblin engineer building a bridge so a laden cart can cross a ravine. Let player construction choices affect whether the cart reaches the other side. Include a short build phase, a visible test run, clear success or failure and a quick retry. Choose the controls, mechanics and visual approach yourself. Keep it small enough to play in a few minutes.
